        hv = f"Bearer {KEY}" if hn == "Authorization" else KEY
        st, h, b = get(BASE + route, headers={hn: hv})
        if st != 302:
            print(f"[HEADER] {route} {hn}: {hv} -> {st} loc={h.get('Location')}")
    # post body api_key
    for body in [{"api_key": KEY}, {"key": KEY}, {"token": KEY}]:
        st, h, b = get(BASE + route, method="POST", data=urllib.parse.urlencode(body).encode())
        if st != 302:
            print(f"[POSTBODY] {route} {body} -> {st} loc={h.get('Location')}")

# API key as login password for various usernames already covered above with KEY in passwords list
print()
print("Done.")
